# libs/ui/src/vendor

> **Keep this file current:** ALWAYS update this CLAUDE.md in the same change whenever code in this directory changes (APIs, layout, commands, invariants, gotchas).

In-tree ports of third-party primitives HeroUI v3.2.6 depends on and that cannot be a dependency (React). Each file header names source, version, licence; `../../NOTICE` carries the licence notices.

## Files

| Path                                           | Source                                                                                                                                                                | What                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `radix-avatar/avatar-primitive.tsx`            | `@radix-ui/react-avatar` 1.2.6 (MIT, © 2022 WorkOS; version from HeroUI's `packages/react/package.json`; ported from the published tarball's `dist/index.mjs`)        | `Root` / `Image` / `Fallback` as `export * as AvatarPrimitive`-shaped named exports. One image loading status per root = `signal` in a context (`Image` outside a root keeps its own); probe (`new window.Image()`, `load` / `error` listeners, `referrerPolicy` + `crossOrigin ?? null` set before `src`, status read from `complete` / `naturalWidth` right after — cached image = `loaded` at once) in a `clientEffect` that re-runs when the accessor-capable `src` / `crossOrigin` / `referrerPolicy` change (cleanup removes the listeners and resets to `idle`); `onLoadingStatusChange` on every observed status change (a second `clientEffect`; cleanup `idle` + next status are one batched change, as React batches them). `Image` renders its `<img>` only while `loaded`, `Fallback` while the root is not `loaded` (+ `delayMs` `setTimeout`). SSR = fallback only. Resumed-page triggers (CEFF 2026-10-28): probe idle only with a `src` (or `onLoadingStatusChange`), the status reporter `interaction`, `Fallback`'s timer idle only with `delayMs`. Dev-only (`#dev`): more than one `Image` per root warns once (text listed in `scripts/zero-cost/dev-leaks.mjs` DEV_MESSAGES + `tests/dev-warning.test.ts`).                                                                                                                          |
| `input-otp/input-otp.tsx` + `input-otp/dom.ts` | `input-otp` 1.5.0 (MIT, © 2024 Guilherme Rodz; version from HeroUI's `packages/react/package.json`; ported from the published tarball's `dist/index.mjs.map` sources) | `OTPInput`, `OTPInputContext` (getters over signals: `slots` computed array, `isFocused`, `isHovering`), `REGEXP_ONLY_*`, `NOSCRIPT_CSS_FALLBACK`, types (`SlotProps`, `RenderProps`, `OTPInputProps`). Transparent input over the container; value = string / accessor / two-way `Signal<string>` / internal signal (`defaultValue`); React controlled input emulated (an `input` event with an unchanged value is ignored, the DOM value restored after a rejected / ignored change); `clientEffect`s (all `when: "interaction"` since CEFF 2026-10-28: a resumed field boots nothing and runs them on its first focus / input / press; limit: a value the browser restores on a history navigation shows in the slots from then on) for the mount work (value sync, document `selectionchange` mirror, one `<style id=input-otp-style>`, `--root-height` + `ResizeObserver`), the 0 / 10 / 50 ms sync timeouts, `onComplete` (COLD-FIX-B 2026-10-27: its previous value starts at the value read at setup, so a full value already in the input when the mount sync runs — a fill / paste before boot — completes; upstream's first run returns on an undefined previous value), password-manager badge (1 s space interval, probes 0 / 2 / 5 s after focus). `dom.ts` = the document-reading helpers (`injectStyles`, `availableBadgeSpace`, `trackPWMBadge`): a `.tsx` module reading browser globals outside handlers / effects fails the server build (RV2001). Element refs = runtime `ref()` (a `signal` passed as `ref` does not resume). No `<noscript>` (inline `<style>` content is a compile error).                                        |

## Rules

- Rivet-ify, do not copy React: signals + `clientEffect`, no `asChild` / scopes. Header lists the source, version, licence and every deviation.
- Live props: parts read props through `splitLive` (no destructure) and spread the rest identifier (`{...rest}`: the compiler binds a native-element identifier spread live, live-props-p4), so a live `class` / `src` / `crossOrigin` / `referrerPolicy` follows.
- Tests live with the consuming component (`../../tests/avatar*.test.tsx`: stubbed `window.Image` with `addEventListener`, attribute order, cached `complete` images; `../../tests-components/avatar.test.ts` resumed probe + accessor `src` swap). input-otp: `../../tests/input-otp*.test.tsx`, Chromium `../../tests-components/forms.test.ts` (keyboard, selection mirror, Backspace, insert).
